description: Source code for system resource monitoring functions, including process info retrieval from /proc filesystem.

methods.name: getFileStream
methods.description: Reads the first line from a specified file into a buffer.

methods.name: procFilename
methods.description: Constructs a process log filename based on directory, postfix, and extension.

methods.name: procStat
methods.description: Retrieves process status information from /proc/[pid]/stat for a given process name.

methods.name: procPid
methods.description: Finds the PID of a process by name.

methods.name: procName
methods.description: Retrieves the process name for a given PID.

methods.name: procStatm
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage info for a process.

methods.name: proc_filename
methods.description: Generates a process log filename, calling procFilename if filename is empty.
